description: This PHP source file defines the IDGeneratorDao class responsible for managing unique identifiers for entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve the current ID and update the next ID for specific entity classes, interacting with a UniqueId entity in the database.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data access object class for generating and managing unique IDs for entities.

methods.name: getCurrentID
methods.description: Retrieves the last used ID for a given entity class from the database.

methods.name: updateNextId
methods.description: Updates the last ID value for a given entity class in the database.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Private helper method that retrieves the table name associated with a given entity class.
